Hip and knee act as one chain during running -- pain or weakness at both joints at once raises the risk of an unstable landing and further joint damage. Prefer walking or low-impact cardio instead.

Two metabolic risk factors together make unsupervised running a more cautious call than either one alone. Build up gradually with a walk-to-run progression and check with your doctor before vigorous activity. Prioritize walking in the meantime.
